text:
erin: heads up - we saw a short but noisy reconnect spike in eu-west after the streaming proxy started emitting partial-EOFs during route handover. reconnect rate ~3.5x for ~11m. some tenants reported duplicate session opens. anyone picked this up?
sam: yes. traced to the proxy change that switched to eager flush on close to reduce tail latency. clients saw partial event then socket close, they retried immediately and resume tokens intermittently rejected.
mina: gist: partial-EOF + immediate close = client SDK treats as broken stream and hard-reconnects without backoff. server-side resume checks saw token namespace bump mid-flight and returned "unrecognized_resume". logs:
```text
2026-11-02T10:12:08Z WARN resume rejected token=rv:eu:9 cause=namespace-mismatch
2026-11-02T10:12:09Z INFO stream closed reason=partial-eof session=aa1b2c
2026-11-02T10:12:09Z INFO new session opened sid=dd4e5f billing_flag=new_open
```
rob: console & canary dashboard showed spike in stream.resume.rejected and stream.new_session.count. alerted SRE and we muted noisy alarms while we triaged.
deploy-bot: proxy-config v12 rolled @ 2026-11-02T10:10:30Z :rocket:
sentry-bot: alert: eu-west reconnect surge detected 2026-11-02T10:12:30Z - magnitude 3.5x - incident I-2026-1102-1
erin: immediate mitigation: reverted eager-flush flag and increased client SDK jitter to add randomized backoff. also preserved old resume-namespace mapping for 90s so late reconnects can still be accepted.
sam: quick patch also added a tolerance window: accept resume token from previous namespace for 60s and increment metric stream.resume.accepted_prev_ns. we will emit trace annotations when that path is used.
mina: product/console ask: can we add a per-rollout "stream-churn risk" heuristic that combines flags like eager-flush, routing-namespace-change, and client-backoff-profile? PMs want explicit warnings in the rollout modal.
rob: ops ask: add an auto-pause canary gate: if stream.new_session.count spike > 2x OR stream.resume.accepted_prev_ns > 0.1% within first 5m, pause rollout. ticket SRE-8402.
erin: billing impact: some affected clients were billed as new opens. pinging billing team. @billing-bot
billing-bot: BILL-998 created: provisional credits for affected tenants, tagging support ops.
sam: long-term proposals: (1) add a resume-handshake idempotency key so reconnects with same cause can be deduped in billing; (2) introduce resume-proofs v2 that include stable issuer epochs and allow +/-1 epoch acceptance with explicit trace tags; (3) change proxy close semantics: emit final "resume-hint" SSE event before socket close to let SDK attempt graceful resume instead of hard reconnect.
mina: telemetry additions: stream.resume.accepted_prev_ns, stream.resume.rejected_namespace, stream.partial_eof.count, trace tag resume.hint_sent=true/false. console should surface these in the canary timeline and a new "dupe-risk" score.
rob: UX ticket created CON-2145 for rollout modal risk banner + confirm step. infra tickets: INFRA-1987 (resume-proofs v2), SRE-8402 (canary auto-pause), SDK-330 (graceful-resume backoff).
erin: small immediate followups: add a dashboard widget that correlates partial-eof events with resume rejects to make root-cause visible. i'll assemble incident notes and timeline later. paste one-line facts here if you hit anything I missed. :memo:
